description: This file provides inline functions to determine if a physical address corresponds to internal RTL838X registers and to map or unmap I/O memory regions based on address ranges specific to the RTL838X series in a MIPS architecture environment.

methods.name: int is_rtl838x_internal_registers(phys_addr_t offset)
methods.description: Checks if a given physical address offset belongs to the RTL838X internal register regions.

methods.name: void __iomem * plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset,unsigned long size,unsigned long flags)
methods.description: Maps a physical address to a virtual memory region if it belongs to RTL838X internal registers.

methods.name: int plat_iounmap(const volatile void __iomem * addr)
methods.description: Determines if the given address corresponds to RTL838X internal registers, effectively unmapping.

ctags.name: plat_ioremap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void __iomem *plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset, unsigned long size,$/
